text:
maya: Timeboxed launch plan for next Tue — paid search + retargeting. CPL goal $45, initial daily budget $3.5k (US + CA).

maya: High level asks — 1) search seed + dayparting, 2) 3 creative variations rotated, 3) retarget windows (7/14/30), 4) inbound webhook to route registrants to SDRs.

sam: got it. for search I propose tCPA with a soft bid cap for first 24h, switch to maximize conversions after initial signal. prefer k=\"target CPA\" at $40 to start.

sam: Also recommend dynamic ad copy with headline pool A/B/C — swap every 48h if CTR < 1.2%.

lina: webinar landing pages ready: LP-A (short form) and LP-B (long form + social proof). LP-A typically converts higher on search, LP-B better for retarget. use LP-A for search, LP-B for retargeting audiences.

tyler: dayparting: frontload 9am-12pm EST for first 3 days, then smooth. add negative keywords list from last quarter: [\"pricing\", \"jobs\", \"open source\"].

maya: retarget windows — 7d for cart/partial form, 14d for site visitors, 30d for cold eng content viewers. exclude converters (registration event) from retarget.

sam: putting automated budget pacing rule in ad console: if spend(first 2h) > 25% of daily_budget then throttle bids by -20%. if CTR>1.5% and CPA<$40 then scale +30%.

sam: rule snippet (pseudo):
```
WHEN hours_since_day_start <= 2 AND spend_pct >= 0.25 THEN set_bids *= 0.8
WHEN CTR >= 0.015 AND CPA <= 40 THEN budget *= 1.3
```

ads-bot: deploy note: campaign \"saturn-launch-search\" created (id: 900442). creative set A/B/C, tracking template applied. :rocket:

lina: for the webhook — make sure we send utm_campaign and utm_content. HubSpot mapping: source=paid_search, campaign=utm_campaign, creative=utm_content. route to SDR queue by geo header (country).

jordan: can we capture per-creative benchmarks for the internal narrative? need impressions/CTR/CVR/CPA per creative + landing page variant every 6h.

maya: yes. add a baked-in eval dashboard tile for \"launch benchmarks\" and populate the first 48h for the narrative doc. jordan, file the template in the drive and tag me.

tyler: small QA: confirm LP-A has form field \"role\" for SDR triage and event name = webinar_saturn_launch. this is what the routing SQL will look like for HubSpot ingestion:
```
SELECT lead_id, email, utm_campaign, utm_content,
CASE WHEN country IN ('US','CA') THEN 'SDR-NA' ELSE 'SDR-EMEA' END as queue
FROM inbound_events
WHERE event_name='webinar_saturn_launch' AND utm_source='paid_search';
```

sam: adding negative placements for retargeting (exclude low-quality apps). will push exclusions list by EOD.

maya: final checklist: creative QA by Mon noon, webhook test Mon 3pm, pacing rule deployed Mon 6pm, go-live Tue 9am EST.

lina: I'll run a dry-run of the webhook with test payload now.

ads-bot: webhook test succeeded (200). payload included utm_campaign=beta_saturn_1, country=US.

jordan: looping in content to prepare the benchmark narrative. will draft headline + 3 talking points after 24h.

maya: great. if any blockers call out here — otherwise we'll proceed to deploy schedule. :thumbsup:
